a.text:
'A Fangshi from afar says there is a great mountain on the northern border called Jing, and atop it sits a mystical stone called Wa.

'Thousands of meters wide and tall, shaped like a jewel, the color of crystal...

'It shines with a brilliant blaze, and a luster that never wanes...'

'It cuts both metal and stone, brings forth all things with methods unknowable, with principles unfathomable...'


'Obtain this miraculous object, and perhaps it will help Yan face the coming calamity.'
'I don't get it, sir. We sacrificed so much for this, yet you intend to hand it over to the House of Yan?'
'That man started the war in the first place, and sent thousands to perish. Why would you aid the despot?'
'We wish to free the masses from suffering, not to aid a single ruler... Fate shall play its hand in time; no one person controls it...'
'I only pray for an early end to the strife, that the people would no longer suffer its torments...'

steps.name: Elderly Voice
steps.text: Ah... yes, yes...!

steps.name: Elderly Voice
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Elderly Voice
steps.text: The 'fate' of Great Yan.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Yo. Still working?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer On Duty
steps.text: Madame Oni—I mean, Hoshiguma Sir...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer On Duty
steps.text: Last Mid-Autumn Festival, Downtown was flooded with people watching the festival lanterns. Patrol didn't have enough hands to keep everyone off the roads; it almost got hairy out there.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer On Duty
steps.text: The Commissioner was fuming over it...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oho. Probably shouldn't have done that.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer On Duty
steps.text: The whole squad got punished for it. Double patrol hours for the month.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer On Duty
steps.text: The Commissioner even told us to be extra careful now, since Chief Wei has been out of town.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sure. Better safe than sorry.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Well, good work, boys. I did just happen to bring in some chow, so share it amongst yourselves.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer On Duty
steps.text: We can't possibly take all this...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: C'mon, listen to your stomach growling. Have a bite.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer On Duty
steps.text: Wait, what was that—

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer On Duty
steps.text: It came out of nowhere. What kind of thunderclap was that?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer On Duty
steps.text: Wait, am I seeing things?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer On Duty
steps.text: Over there, in the sky... what is that?

spans.text: Over there, in the sky... what

steps.name: Excited Tourist
steps.text: Boatman, slow us down. Look over there, do you see something on the river?

steps.name: Excited Tourist
steps.text: A beckbeast? But how is it on the river, and it's carrying... a goblet?

spans.text: A beckbeast? But how is it
the river, and it's carrying... a goblet?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Just a mirage. What's so special about that, don't you get those in Kou-wu City?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: (...Break.)

steps.name: Excited Tourist
steps.text: Huh, what's with the sudden rain...? Where'd the beckbeast go?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Autumn rain this year... may well freeze my bones.

steps.name: Yanese Soldier
steps.text: Reporting in! Report—

steps.name: Yanese Soldier
steps.text: The Feranmut... has reached the final sentry post!

steps.name: Yanese Soldier
steps.text: Red alert! Repeat, all units on maximum alert!

steps.name: Yanese Soldier
steps.text: Wo kao...

steps.name: Yanese Soldier
steps.text: That thing doesn't look like a 'creature' at all... that's a damned mountain...!

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Excuse me, sir.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: The Grand Commandant is sick abed, and will not see anyone, so please—

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: Is the Grand Commandant in?

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Y-Yes!

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: Bring me to him.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... *cough* *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: ...In my fevered dreams, it was as if I'd seen the late...

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: I had thought... you were the late emperor, here to take me away.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: I know you often think of the late emperor...

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: But I fear anxiety has addled your brain, if you're thinking about your end already.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: Your Imperial Majesty... you honor me with your presence...

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: Forgive this servant... I've failed to rise for even a salutation...

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: How have you deteriorated so greatly, in the few days since our last meeting?

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: Are you taking your medicine?

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: I beg Your Majesty's understanding...

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: This consumption is a stubborn, chronic illness... The abnormal weather this Mid-Autumn struck with a cold...

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: I fear this wizened shell may not make it through the winter...

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: You are a trusted servant of Great Yan and should not sell yourself short.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: How could the same man, who once kept countless foreign foes halted at our gates, dread a mere cold?

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: Be at ease, and convalesce. I await your swift recovery, and for you to share my burdens and aid the nation once you are well.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... This addled servant... is in truth, ill-suited to the task.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: Great Yan today is rich with talent. Your Imperial Majesty decides all matters, great and small, so why seek counsel from this withered servant...?

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: So the Grand Commandant is unsatisfied with my arbitrary actions, and wishes to return home due to his illness.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: I... This humble servant would never dare...

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: In the last two weeks, ministers across the bureaucracy and all throughout the land have stacked petitions urging war high on my desk.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: Every one is passionate, and a few I would venture to call desperate.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: So for the Grand Commandant to claim illness at this hour, is this to compel me to...?

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... Your Majesty is indeed aware...

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: All Yanese share a view on this age-old problem...

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: Your Majesty may not believe me, but ought to have faith in this...

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: The will of the people'.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: I'll be willing to try any other possible solution, as long as we can avoid spilling the blood of our troops too readily.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: I had thought you would know best my mind on the matter.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: Your Majesty is well-versed in our history... *cough*—surely you must know...?

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: Across the many times the blood that ought be shed... when was it ever avoidable...?

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: One ought to act swiftly when necessary. Indecisive efforts for want of perfection will only lead to more bloodshed.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: I had thought... Your Majesty understood this long ago...

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: It has been more than two weeks since the great offender entered the Tomb of Sui, but his fate remains unknown.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: All Great Yan is in an uproar, not only due to the five Feranmuts, but the presence of foreign foes as well...

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: Leave him in the Tomb for even one more day, and the danger to Great Yan will increase tenfold.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: This is not my opinion alone...

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: Even if I could temporarily suppress public sentiments for Your Majesty's sake... it would be no true solution...

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: So, how do you want to go about it?

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: I cannot ask Your Majesty to rescind an imperial edict...

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: I can only make an earnest request... to set a day.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: ...A final deadline until which Great Yan must hold.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: Whether or not blood should have ever been shed will be determined thousands of years from now by historians and common folk alike.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: But for now, I am afraid neither the Grand Commandant, nor I, will get to make that determination.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: Is it Great Yan that cannot hold, or the collective lust for glory?

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: ...Your Imperial Majesty...

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: But your request is not without merit.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: I recall, it was the day after the full moon when he went in...

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: The next day of the full moon it is.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: If the man fails to achieve anything in the Tomb of Sui, then we will proceed as the Grand Commandant proposes.

steps.name: Grand Commandant
steps.text: Your Imperial Majesty... is wise and just...

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: Let it be so.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: A cold is no grave illness, Grand Commandant, but convalescence is still important.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: I hear Danyan's snow pears are a great expectorant. I'll send for some.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: Finish the pears before you rest for the night, and your illness should be cured in the morning.

steps.name: Shadowy Figure
steps.text: I will hold court early tomorrow. Do not be late.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Are we... outside?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Those Feranmut proxies... have quite the mystical prowess.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Is the Placation finally complete?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Perhaps...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No... just how many times have we tried? Is that complete?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: How long have we spent in the Garden of Grotesqueries?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Based on the dates on the Tianshi Bureau's terminal... it's been more than two weeks since we entered the Garden.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: More than half a month? Why do I feel as if we've spent even longer than that...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: We don't know if anything's happened in the Tomb of Sui since we've been here...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Zuo, you asked 'how many times'...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm getting the sense this isn't our first time standing on this spot.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Concluding the Placation, taking the jade rule, leaving the Garden, and going back to town... I feel like we've done it all multiple times, and also...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Sometimes it's Mr. Yi who greets us, while other times the weiqi player blocks our path.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Sometimes the bestial Hou turns into a butterfly and gravely injures the bestial Sui... but other times we fall into a geist trap and get chased out of the Garden for no apparent reason.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: And this hunch isn't a recent realization?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It was a faint feeling at first, but it was only just now that I suddenly realized we seem to have been repeating our Garden visits.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: If that is the case, maybe the Placation is finally complete?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: ...I certainly hope that's the case.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Right, who has the token? It seems Mr. Yi hands the rule to a different person each time we complete the rite...

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I don't have it.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Neither do I.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Then—
A small object falls from Zuo Le's pocket.
To everyone's surprise, it is no jade rule, but a tiny 'doll'.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Auntie Lin, Yun... Have we seen this before?
Yo, so you made it out alive. Pretty tough, huh?

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Zushi!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Zu... Zushi.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Why are you calling me that when you're not even a Tianshi disciple, kiddo?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Um, how should I address you then...?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Who cares about titles? Your qinggong's good and you move quick, so just get to wherever you need to be.

spans.text: good and you move quick, so just get to wherever you need to be.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Where do I need to be...?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: What should a Candleholder do after getting the token from the Garden?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Return to the Sui Regulator and submit the jade rule along with a report.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Then begone! No more dawdling!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But the jade rule—

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: A token's a token. Maybe there's a reason you didn't get the jade rule this time, but just hurry back to the Sui Regulator already. Or are you scared that proxy's gonna report you for theft?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Qianbei, there's something I'd like to ask about Baizao—

spans.text: there's something I'd like to ask about Baizao—

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Just be quick. Who's the Candleholder here, you or me?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Won't you know the answer once you see the city yourself anyway?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Act your age. I'm sure you know how to adapt to a situation, don't you?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: I'll go with Zuo Le.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: You stay.

steps.name: Lin Qingyan
steps.text: Zushi...?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Baizao doesn't have much use for a judiciary at the moment, so it'd be a pointless trip for you. You'll be more useful here.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Same goes for the Yun kid. Neither of you is a member of Sui Regulator, so stay. You'll make less trouble for all of us.
The three exchange glances, and silently agree to the Tianshi's directive.
Zuo Le puts the token back into his pocket, and after bidding farewell to the party, leaps off northward.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Old... Qianbei, there's something I want to ask...

spans.text: there's something I want to ask...

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Where is the young lady who claimed to be of the Shanhaizhong, the one you took away before we entered the Tomb?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Oh? I didn't think a dimwit like you would concern yourself with that lass.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: I just remembered, she mentioned there was something from the Garden that could keep Yan and the bestial Sui from coming to blows.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: You granted us permission to enter the Garden, but you didn't examine the token Zuo Le had at all.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Does that mean... you believe she spoke the truth?

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: How intriguing... Smarty pants like you are so different from the martial types.

steps.name: Yun Qingping
steps.text: Of course, I believe you have your reasons for sending him alone, but I'm worried Zuo Le might come to harm if the token is truly important.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: Hmph, to speak of safety... no one's truly safe right now.

steps.name: 'Old Tianshi'
steps.text: If that kid really has what it takes to be a Candleholder, now's the time to show it.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: What's wrong? I rarely ever see you so down.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: I just worry they might not manage to deliver that token.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: Those who know what the token truly is can only stand and watch, while those helping us don't even know where it should go.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: That Old Tianshi has already done us a grand favor. The rest is up to the family's fate.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: I didn't think those youths would get involved in this, and I'm not sure whether to be relieved or worried.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: Many have come to this garden over the past century.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: But this group of youngsters was the first to retrieve that glimmer of hope from our memories left behind and bring it back to this realm.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: No matter what, we must believe that their fates are somewhat linked to ours.

steps.name: Liang
steps.text: You speak sense, sir.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: Well, myriad sights abound in the land, but encounters are still up to fate.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: You could buy a ticket early, do your research, memorize the map, stand outside the garden until it opens... but then a storm comes, and you see nothing at all.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: Or you could enter through a random side gate and roam around aimlessly, but as long as you have a goal in mind, you might be pleasantly surprised by what you find.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: Visitors come with interest, but it always wanes with time... It's not proper to force this enthusiasm to endure.

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: So let's just relax and wait here, and protect this garden...

steps.name: Yi
steps.text: This beautiful place is honestly quite difficult to abandon.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: What a bother. I'm getting a sore throat repeating the same argument over and over.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: We're back to square one, no? Thousands of years we've debated, and it seems nothing's getting through that thick head of yours.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: You're the stubborn one. Whatever scholarly talents you have are negated by your expertise in nonsensical argumentation.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: The truth is simple—there is no order without rules. To live in this realm, one must be able to tell right from wrong.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: If it really is as you say, for everyone to blur boundaries and confuse right and wrong, what sort of chaos will befall this realm?

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Preposterous... Your insistence on adherence to rules is nothing more than locking yourself in a prison of your own making.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: Let me ask you then. To build a room, a house, a city, a moat—there are rules to follow, yes.

steps.name: Wizened Voice
steps.text: But when we measure merits and errors made in history, or the hearts of the masses—what rules or metrics are we to abide by?

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: Of course, rules are made to fit the situation, and for mortal benefit.

steps.name: Sullen Voice
steps.text: When have I ever said rules should be set for the sake of having them?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Where... are we?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...And who are you?

steps.name: Plain-Dressed Elder
steps.text: Fine, fine... then let me ask you this.

steps.name: Plain-Dressed Elder
steps.text: You say we must have rules, but then who should set them in the first place?

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Artisan
steps.text: The virtuous, of course—only they can convince the masses, and rules can only stand when accepted by all.

steps.name: Plain-Dressed Elder
steps.text: Don't you see the problem with that?

steps.name: Plain-Dressed Elder
steps.text: We have to first find virtuous people to set rules, but what deems one virtuous? Doesn't it mean we have to lay down some rules to find these people?

steps.name: Plain-Dressed Elder
steps.text: Ju, the ten thousand years of your life have been a waste, if you can't even decide if the fowlbeast or egg came first.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Artisan
steps.text: Hah! You're just unreasonably putting the cart before the burdenbeast to suit your fallacy.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Artisan
steps.text: We already have rules called 'righteousness'. You think they just appeared from thin air?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: What are you talking about...?

steps.name: Plain-Dressed Elder
steps.text: Oh, look. This one's about to wake up too.

steps.name: Plain-Dressed Elder
steps.text: Awake? Or dreaming?

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Artisan
steps.text: Do you even have to ask? Just look at her, all lost. Obviously, she's dreaming.

steps.name: Plain-Dressed Elder
steps.text: Awake in a dream, yet not truly woken. The girl is suffering from a headache over the dilemma she faces.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Artisan
steps.text: If you're stubborn and refuse to see sense, you'll surely run up against barriers, both physical and mental.

steps.name: Plain-Dressed Elder
steps.text: You're right about that... her knowing and doing don't match. She's contradicting herself—wants non-action, yet also wants to act.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Artisan
steps.text: Now, she seeks a tangible form of 'justice', and even wants to pocket it and take it away. I think she's far more obsessed than that good-for-nothing disciple of mine.

steps.name: Peculiar-looking Artisan
steps.text: Yes, how could she enjoy such a delusional dream if she weren't the most obsessed person walking this realm?

steps.name: Plain-Dressed Elder
steps.text: No need to be so harsh, Ju. Plenty of people out there climb trees to catch fins or strike ice to make fire. What can we even do?

steps.name: Plain-Dressed Elder
steps.text: But you're right about one thing...

steps.name: Plain-Dressed Elder
steps.text: Is this girl an obsessed one, or what...?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Who—

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: What's the matter with you?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Nothing...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Did you not hear any of that?

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: You're so weird. You've been staring into blank space for a while now.

steps.name: Aloof Woman
steps.text: Did those geists give you a concussion? Don't suppose there's anything I can do about that.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Thanks. I'm not quite—

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I just feel like...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I've been here before...
